userStories.title: Shared core: lineage preservation, finished-iteration resolver, dock mode, poll error callback
userStories.description: As a web developer, I want the shared libs to preserve full loop ancestry on occurrence rows and resolve a provably same-lineage live iteration, so that both shells can expose a `finished-iteration` dock mode that fails closed on any identity doubt.
acceptanceCriteria: `ExecutionLoopAncestryEntry { readonly nodeId: string; readonly iteration: number }` is exported from `packages/web/src/lib/execution-room-model.ts`, and `loopAncestry?: readonly ExecutionLoopAncestryEntry[]` is added to the `occurrence` arm of `ExecutionRowSelection` (:13-24) plus both local `LogRowSelection` copies

Both `packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-log-rows.ts` (:95-115) and `packages/web/src/experiments/console/components/inspect/build-log-rows.ts` map every wire `loop_ancestry` `{node_id, iteration}` entry to `{nodeId, iteration}` preserving order; existing final `iteration`, route, retry, id, status, and labels are unchanged; event-fallback rows do not fabricate ancestry

`FinishedIterationView { readonly liveRowId: string; readonly liveIteration: number }` and `resolveFinishedIterationView()` are exported beside `chooseExecutionForNode()` (execution-room-model.ts:132) as a pure function taking all rows, selected row, projected node status, and run liveness

The resolver returns non-null only when: run is live AND node status is `running`/`awaiting`; selected row is a known-scope `occurrence` that is `completed` with non-empty ancestry whose final entry equals its displayed iteration; a known-scope candidate for the same `nodeId` is `running`/`awaiting` with ancestry agreement and iteration > selected; and both have identical `retryEpoch ?? 0`, identical optional `routeActivationSeq` (both-absent never equals a numeric value), same final ancestry `nodeId`, and same ancestry prefix (nodeId+iteration per prefix entry)

Candidate preference is `awaiting` then `running` then greatest `order`; terminal rows are never a fallback; `node`, `loop_iteration`, `route_iteration`, unknown-scope, empty/malformed ancestry, same-or-earlier iteration, terminal node/run, and old event-fallback rows all return null

`SteeringDockMode` (steering-dock.ts:50) gains `'finished-iteration'`; `steeringDockMode()` (:68) accepts `finishedIteration?: FinishedIterationView | null` with precedence: `!live -> hidden`; `finishedIteration` non-null -> `'finished-iteration'`; `rowStatus` not running/awaiting -> `hidden`; existing blocked -> detached -> composer order unchanged; exact disclosure and `Go to iteration N` label helpers are exported matching the ratified copy

`QueuePollingOptions` (steering-dock.ts:351) gains an optional `onError` callback receiving the normalized `SteeringSendError`, invoked once per failed read before the existing retry/stop decision; callers that omit it behave exactly as today (422 notify+continue, next 200 clears, network/5xx silent retry, 409 notify+stop, other 4xx notify+stop)

Test-first per phase-01 matrix: new cases in `execution-room-model.test.ts`, `steering-dock.test.ts`, and both `build-log-rows.test.ts` files are written before implementation and all pass, including the fail-closed identity matrix and the visibility-table regression
Web package type-check, lint, and test scripts pass per `packages/web/package.json`; no server, generated API, workflow schema, database, or migration files are touched
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 1 implementation contract + test matrix. Resolver lives in execution-room-model.ts (lineage reasoning), not steering-dock.ts (mode/copy only). Keep the callback optional so rollback needs no endpoint or persisted-data change. Run: cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/execution-room-model.test.ts src/lib/steering-dock.test.ts src/components/workflows/build-log-rows.test.ts src/experiments/console/components/inspect/build-log-rows.test.ts
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 2. Files: execution-room-model.ts (+ ancestry types, resolveFinishedIterationView), both build-log-rows.ts (full loopAncestry map), steering-dock.ts (finished-iteration mode, copy helpers, optional onError), and matching unit tests. Commit 527bd475.

userStories.title: Legacy shell renders and wires the finished-iteration dock
userStories.description: As an operator on the Legacy shell, I want the finished-iteration descriptor computed once at the pane and rendered as a read-only dock with a working Go control, so that I can see queued guidance and return to the live iteration without any mutation path.
acceptanceCriteria: `LegacyGraphLogsPane.tsx` calls `resolveFinishedIterationView()` once with `rows`, `selectedRow`, the selected node's visible state, and run liveness; the `{liveRowId, liveIteration}` descriptor plus the existing row-selection callback are threaded through `LegacyNodeRoom.tsx` -> `NodeTranscriptPane.tsx` -> `ComposerDock.tsx` as the only new props (never the whole row list)
A host with no usable row-selection callback passes no descriptor and renders no finished dock — no enabled Go control with no action

The `finished-iteration` branch in `ComposerDock.tsx` renders in DOM order: exact disclosure; native `Go to iteration N` button; 422 detached alert when present; the full-width queue band only when `sent.length > 0` — reusing `queueBandHeader()`, `queueListLabel()`, server order, message text, `sent` label, and `max-h-[33vh] overflow-y-auto` with no delete controls

The branch contains no textarea, send hint, Queue/Send control, delete button, or bound send/withdraw/interrupt handler; polling enablement includes `finished-iteration` so only `readQueue` (GET) runs; spies observe zero mutations after pointer and keyboard interaction

Poll errors in this branch: 422 `not_steerable_here` shows `STEERING_DETACHED_DISCLOSURE` as an alert below the disclosure and clears the displayed snapshot while polling continues; the next 200 clears the alert and restores the authoritative snapshot; network/5xx retry silently with last snapshot retained; 409 clears the snapshot and stops polling and is never labeled detached; send/withdraw refusal state and draft persistence are untouched

Go activation stores `liveRowId` and invokes the existing selection callback only; `NodeTranscriptPane.tsx` owns a consume-once focus target cleared before focusing — live/blocked target focuses the composer textarea, a target that became finished focuses the new Go button, a disappeared dock focuses the transcript scroller; focus never lands on `<body>` and unrelated refetches/remounts never steal focus
The `(runId, nodeId)` draft is hidden in finished mode and restored unchanged on return; queue order is preserved across the round trip

Approved visual contract holds at 460px and wide widths: one structural control row, complete disclosure wraps in its flexible cell, Go fully visible >=32px with surface focus ring, no horizontal overflow, band below capped at 33vh

Tests per phase-02 matrix pass: `ComposerDock.test.tsx` (copy, ordered band, no mutation surface, Go callback, draft hide/restore, 422/200/network/5xx/409 semantics, existing modes unchanged) plus parent/room integration coverage in `LegacyGraphLogsPane.test.tsx`/`NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx` for descriptor production, fail-closed mismatches, selection transition, and all three focus outcomes
Web package type-check, lint, and test scripts pass
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 2 Legacy half. Keep NodeTranscriptPane as the surviving owner of the consume-once focus ref (keyed ComposerDock remounts). A small local render helper inside ComposerDock is acceptable; no cross-surface abstraction. Test at ownership boundaries, not every pass-through.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 3. Files: LegacyGraphLogsPane.tsx (resolve once + gate on onSelectExecution), LegacyNodeRoom.tsx (pass-through), NodeTranscriptPane.tsx (consume-once focus handoff), ComposerDock.tsx (finished-iteration branch + poll onError), matching tests. Commit 5418cce5.

userStories.title: Console shell renders and wires the finished-iteration dock
userStories.description: As an operator on the Console shell, I want the same finished-iteration dock rendered through Console's own components, so that both surfaces expose identical copy, controls, band semantics, failure state, and focus behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `ConsoleInspectPane.tsx` calls `resolveFinishedIterationView()` once with `logEntries.map(entry => entry.row)`, `selectedRow`, the selected node state, and `isInspectRunLive(run.status)` (`experiments/console/components/inspect/inspect-status.ts:21`); the descriptor plus the existing selection callback are threaded to `ConsoleNodeRoom.tsx` -> `ConsoleComposerDock.tsx`
A host with no usable row-selection callback passes no descriptor and renders no finished dock

`ConsoleComposerDock.tsx` renders the identical DOM order and content as Legacy — disclosure, Go button, 422 alert, conditional read-only band with `queueBandHeader`/`queueListLabel`/server order/`sent`/`max-h-[33vh]` — using Console surface-specific classes; Console imports no Legacy component (HITL AD-4)

No textarea, send hint, Queue/Send control, delete button, or bound mutation handler is reachable; polling in this mode performs only `readQueue`; zero send/withdraw/interrupt calls under pointer and keyboard interaction

Identical poll-error semantics: 422 -> detached alert + cleared snapshot, keep polling; 200 -> clears alert, restores snapshot; network/5xx -> silent retry with last snapshot; 409 -> cleared snapshot + stop, never labeled detached

`ConsoleNodeRoom.tsx` owns the consume-once focus ref with the same three outcomes (live composer textarea / new Go button / transcript scroller), cleared before focusing, never `<body>`, never stolen by unrelated refetches
Draft and queue order survive the Go round trip; keyboard activation (Enter/Space) works via native button behavior
Same visual contract at 460px and 1440px: one control row, wrapping complete disclosure, Go >=32px fully visible, no horizontal overflow, band capped at 33vh

Tests per phase-02 matrix pass: `ConsoleComposerDock.test.tsx` renderer coverage mirroring the Legacy list plus parent/room integration coverage in `ConsoleInspectPane.test.tsx`/`ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx`; existing composer/blocked/detached/hidden renderer behavior stays green
Web package type-check, lint, and test scripts pass
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 2 Console half — mirror of US-003, deliberately a parallel thin renderer rather than a shared component. Reuse `isInspectRunLive` rather than inventing a second liveness list.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 4. Files: ConsoleInspectPane.tsx (resolve once + isInspectRunLive), ConsoleNodeRoom.tsx (consume-once focus handoff), ConsoleComposerDock.tsx (finished-iteration branch + poll onError), matching tests. Commit 04d0e37b.

userStories.title: Real-loop E2E journey on both shells plus regression sweep
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an event-driven Playwright journey through the real executor on both shells, so that Story 2.10's read-only, GET-only, focus, and visual contracts are proven against live loop behavior rather than mocks.
acceptanceCriteria: `e2e/ui/agent-finished-iteration.spec.ts` exists, parameterized over `legacy` and `console` projects with stable verification ids `steer.finished-iteration-legacy` and `steer.finished-iteration-console` in test names and evidence mapping

The spec reuses `e2e/fixtures/workflows/e2e-queue-guidance-loop.yaml` via `E2E_QUEUE_GUIDANCE_LOOP_WORKFLOW_NAME` / `QUEUE_GUIDANCE_LOOP_NODE` from the archon runtime helpers — no duplicate fixture, constant, or registration path — with event polling on `loop_iteration_completed`/`loop_iteration_started` (no fixed sleeps) and a budget >= `T.xlong * 2`; each surface runs in its own run

Journey per shell: start the loop, wait for iteration 1 complete + iteration 2 start; queue a unique message on live iteration 2 and assert `queued · 1`; record requests from before selecting iteration 1 via the existing `Execution` control; while iteration 1 is selected assert exact disclosure naming iteration 2, the native Go control, the ordered read-only band containing the unique message with `sent`, no textarea/hint/Queue/Send/delete controls, at least one successful node-scoped queue GET, and zero send/queue-delete/interrupt mutations

At 460x900 and 1440x900 assert by DOM measurement: no horizontal overflow, Go fully visible >=32px, approved disclosure treatment, band width, and 33vh cap; capture screenshots for both shells as review evidence
Activate Go by keyboard: assert `Execution` shows iteration 2, the textarea owns focus, and the same message order plus stored draft are present

Finish the run via the fake provider's `doneWhenPromptIncludes` directive on the latest iteration, wait for completion, re-select a completed iteration on the now non-live run, and assert the dock is absent
Event-to-assertion elapsed times are recorded as test annotations; identity-negative cases (retry/route/nested/fallback/different-run) remain covered by unit/renderer tests, not extra real runs

If issue #188 is already merged and operator transcript rows exist in code (operator kind in `agent-history.ts`, operator metadata in `nodeTranscriptMetadataSchema`, executor drain receipts in `dag-executor.ts`), also include the AC 4 assertions (delivered guidance appears exactly once as an operator row in the selected occurrence and is absent from the pending band, disclosure/Go now naming the next live iteration); otherwise AC 4 assertions are owned by US-006
`_bmad-output/specs/spec-agent-node-room/steering-test-plan.md` gains the two Story 2.10 verification ids mapped to the journeys and their unit/renderer support

The new spec passes on both projects, and the affected specs `agent-queue-guidance.spec.ts`, `agent-withdraw-guidance.spec.ts`, `agent-queue-convergence.spec.ts`, and `occurrence-navigation.spec.ts` still pass, invoked per `e2e/package.json` scripts (Bun-managed, not `npx`)
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 3 E2E implementation, minus the #188-gated closure steps. Precedents: agent-queue-guidance.spec.ts and agent-queue-convergence.spec.ts for request recording/room opening/viewports/fake provider; occurrence-navigation.spec.ts for execution-select helpers (lift to shared helper only if this becomes their third stable caller). Recorded request count corroborates no overlap/mutation — never assert a brittle exact poll count.

userStories.title: Closure: #188-gated AC 4 evidence, acceptance report, doc sync, sprint status
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want Story 2.10 closed only when every criterion — including the Story 2.8-backed AC 4 — has passing evidence, so that #190 is never closed on a waived criterion and the sprint tracker reflects reality.
acceptanceCriteria: Precondition verified first: issue #188 is merged (`gh issue view 188`) AND operator-row support exists in code (operator kind in `packages/web/src/lib/agent-history.ts`, operator metadata in `nodeTranscriptMetadataSchema`, executor drains writing receipts in `packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts`); if absent, leave this story unpassed — do not reimplement Story 2.8 and do not waive AC 4

With #188 present, the AC 4 E2E assertions (in or added to `agent-finished-iteration.spec.ts`) pass on both shells: delivered guidance appears exactly once as an operator transcript row inside the selected occurrence and is absent from the pending queue band; disclosure/Go name the new live iteration

`plans/reports/acceptance-<date>-issue-190-finished-iteration.md` maps every issue/Story 2.10 criterion (AC 1-5 plus the B1/B2 ratification and fail-closed identity criteria) to a named test or captured observation; none is marked deferred
Screenshots and concise network/measurement artifacts are stored under `plans/reports/evidence/issue-190/` containing fixture-only text — no credentials, tokens, personal data, or full CI logs

`epics.md`, `SPEC.md`, `control-states.md`, `EXPERIENCE.md`, `DESIGN.md`, and the new AD are re-read against shipped behavior and any drift is corrected without duplicating implementation detail into evergreen docs

`bun run validate` passes from the repo root; `git diff --check` is clean; the new spec is re-run at normal CI worker/retry configuration and duration compared against the recorded baseline; no failure is replaced with a skip, timeout increase, or weakened assertion

Only after all criteria pass: `2-10-see-queued-guidance-while-viewing-a-finished-iteration` in `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/agent-node-room/sprint-status.yaml` is set to `done`, with no unrelated stale entries touched

PR hygiene per plan: repository PR template, target `develop`, link the evidence report, `Closes #190` only on the completion PR; if Phase 1/2 UI merged earlier it used `Refs #190` with the sprint item left open
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase 3 closure. B3 is a hard gate: #188 is the existing owner of operator transcript rows. This story may legitimately remain unpassed if #188 has not merged — that is the plan's sequencing, not a failure to retry around.
